asker: a founder who already has customers here and wants to know how big it gets
why: A real but tiny market, seeded from the word alone. Harvesting the businesses that rank for it (it-13) opens it into the whole field-service-management category — 907 keywords and 649,450 searches a month — which is a different market and a fair thing to be confident about. This case exists to test the register used on a thin corpus, so it keeps one: `no_harvest`.
